title: the tester casts a red tooth an open ticket only bounds, not one it declares
intention: The tester's red-cast door casts a red tooth no open ticket is for, even when an open ticket names that tooth's proof in bounds.in: a bounding ticket carries only the teeth it declares in that proof's PROVES; fixes stays a whole-proof carry.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendell (akiendell_cc_0): test_rehearsal's tooth test_the_sixth_pass_opens_one_question_naming_the_standing_gaps_and_reads_nothing went red and the red-cast door returned cast: []. The red was cast by hand as c420501acb0b. Measured here: the open carrier is fb42e9a6842f (TICKETME), which bounds cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.py for an unrelated change (a record fixture) and declares no tooth in it; 79718ec09198, named in c420's commit, is PROVED and carries nothing. The tooth is declared by cf80bdb57205. red_tickets.ticket_what_is_new skips every red item whose proof path is in any open ticket's bounds.in, so one unrelated bound swallows every red on that proof.
traces_to: Outline 9.4.2.3.7.5 (reds don't get lost: a ticket for every new red 'unless one is already open for it'); Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth: a swallowed cast is a lost red).
how: In red_tickets.carried(), keep fixes as the per-proof path carry (207c4074b3d5 D1). Turn the bounds carry into red keys: an open ticket bounding proof P carries red:P::T for each tooth T it declares under its own id in P's PROVES (proof_coverage.declared), and red:P::* when it declares any. ticket_what_is_new drops carried keys from each red item, skips an item with none left, and casts the rest with only the uncarried keys. 207c's tooth 3 fixture gains a PROVES declaration for its bounding ticket so it still casts nothing.

clauses.claim: a fixture proof P declaring teeth T1 (for ticket C) and T2; an open ticket B bounds P and declares nothing in it; T2 reds: one ticket is cast carrying red:P::T2
the open ticket C bounds P and declares T1; T1 reds: nothing is cast
an open ticket lists P in fixes and declares nothing; T2 reds: nothing is cast
T1 and T2 red and C bounds P declaring T1: one ticket is cast whose keys name T2 and not T1

decisions.text: D1: carried() returns (fixes paths, bound red keys); a bounding ticket carries only the red keys of the teeth it declares in the proof's PROVES, plus red:P::* when it declares any; supersedes 207c4074b3d5 D3's whole-proof bounds carry and keeps its why (a red-first proof's ticket carries its own red).
D2: ticket_what_is_new casts a partly carried red item with only its uncarried keys, and skips one with none left; fixes and orphans unchanged.
D3: a new proof drives ticket_what_is_new over a fixture commons, one tooth per clause; 207c's tooth 3 fixture declares its bounding ticket's tooth in RED so its expected outcome holds.
